verifiedExistingCompletionChain.conditionCommit: PhotoWorld content actions use RuntimeBridge.DispatchContentApplyAsync; it captures the expected RuntimeKernel session, dispatches authored conditions/effects, then verifies the same session and calls ReconcileQuestsAsync(session) after commit.
verifiedExistingCompletionChain.allObjectiveBehavior: ReconcileAsync traverses every compiled active quest and allows sum(objective counts)+1 passes; each pass refreshes, checks active status and completionConditions, then dispatches an eligible objective with QuestLifecycleReducer.ObjectiveOccurrenceId. It does not impose a one-objective contract. The currently compiled W01-W05 each happen to author one main objective.
verifiedExistingCompletionChain.reducer: QuestLifecycleReducer rechecks every objective completionConditions, applies authored objective effects, honors objective/stage composition and transitions, and sets quest status completed only when the final stage completes (src-dotnet/Urman.Core/Quests/QuestLifecycleReducer.cs:251-330).
verifiedExistingCompletionChain.atomicityAndReplay: Each quest/objective lifecycle dispatch is a RuntimeKernel transaction with occurrence-ledger duplicate protection. The chapter-level reconcile loop spans multiple lifecycle dispatches; it is not one atomic chapter transaction.
verifiedExistingCompletionChain.existingAutomaticPathImplication: When real canonical facts are committed, this existing coordinator/reducer chain already completes eligible objectives. A chapter command that only calls the same reconcile would add no new behavior and is rejected as a no-op alias.
